specs.source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/README.md §0.4 'Chips' and 'Workspace tags'; 'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' #sys 'Chips — three kinds, three shapes' block; operator ruling 2.5
notes: Chips.tsx is pure inline style (media queries only affect <768px, not this 1440 mount); every property here is a real product value.

Ruling 2.5 restates the family rules (band = tinted pill + round dot; workspace tag = square dot, removable; kind/mode/topic = neutral, no dot, no border; tier = the only bordered chip) without new numbers for band/tier/tag beyond what the artboard states, so the artboard markup is the numeric source for those three.

TagChip has no `border` set at all (correct per ruling 2.5's 'no dot, NO border'); the artboard's neutral tag also has no border rule. Both sides agree, not asserted as a property since 'unset' has no single canonical getComputedStyle form worth comparing.

CONFIRMED, verified not a harness artefact: `--radius-pill` computes to nothing (CSSOM initial value, 0) in the real product, not just this harness. src/app/theme.css declares it TWICE inside the SAME plain `:root{}` rule (no `@theme` involved, no Tailwind step in play): line 55 `--radius-pill: 999px;`, then line 201 `--radius-pill: var(--radius-pill);` — a property declared in terms of itself, which CSS defines as invalid, and the invalid LATER declaration wins over the valid earlier one within one rule (there is no 'fall back to the earlier declaration' in CSS custom properties). Every chip that reads `var(--radius-pill)` — BandChip, WorkspaceTagPill, and TagChip (see next note) — renders SQUARE corners everywhere in the shipped product, not just in this measurement. Confirmed by probing `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--radius-pill')` directly against theme.css alone (empty string) before writing this spec.

TagChip's radius is a second, separate issue on top of the broken token: even if `--radius-pill` were fixed to 999px, the artboard's neutral tag uses `border-radius:4px` (a squared tag, matching the tier chip's own 4px-square convention), not a pill — TagChip.tsx reaches for the pill token where the design wants the square one.

FIXED by fix58-tokens (2026-09-07): removed theme.css's self-referential `--radius-pill: var(--radius-pill);` redeclaration (it carried no independent value and only broke the earlier valid one); `--radius-pill` now resolves to 999px sitewide. TagChip.tsx also switched to `border-radius:4px` (the design's square-tag value, not the pill token).

notes: This spec measures the COMPOSED page, region by region, in document order — the operator's own complaint was placement, not part styling ('the filters were not above the regulations, they were on the right ... you are NOT matching the images directly'). operations-matrix.json still measures RegionDimensionMatrix alone (six D1-D6 rows, ruling 3.3); this one measures where that matrix SITS and what surrounds it.

The audit asserts geometry, placement and the components' own literals, never fixture values.

The runner reads computed STYLE and textContent only: an `expect` key naming an HTML attribute (e.g. an input's placeholder) measures as null and reports a false MATCH, so no such key appears here. The page-scoped command-bar prompt artboard 08 states is verified in the side-by-side evidence PNG (docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/built/compose-08-operations-list.png), not by this spec.

Placement assertions use sibling-combinator selectors, which match only when the first element's DOM node PRECEDES the second's — 'present but in the wrong place' was the defect, so absence-only checks would not have caught it.

R7 (an app feature the artboard does not draw is kept, listed, and moved out of an artboard region's position): the US By-state cost sub-list moved from between the matrix and the first band card to the disclosure position at the foot of the content column; the Mode facet stays but sits after the artboard's own REGION and DIMENSION groups. SITEWIDE FINDING, confirmed live (not a harness artefact): both filter-chip border-radius checks below measure 0px against theme.css's own --radius-pill:999px token. Root cause, confirmed by reading src/app/theme.css line 213: `--radius-pill: var(--radius-pill);` — a CUSTOM PROPERTY THAT REFERENCES ITSELF inside the same :root block that first declares `--radius-pill: 999px` at line 55. Per the CSS custom-properties spec, a property whose computed value cycles back to itself is 'guaranteed-invalid' and resolves to nothing wherever it is USED (there is no fallback in the `var(--radius-pill)` calls that consume it) — a definition-order bug, not a consumer bug. This is not scoped to FilterChip: every pill-radius shared part that reads `var(--radius-pill)` (BandChip, TagChip, WorkspaceTagPill, FilterChip — all in Chips.tsx) renders a SQUARE corner sitewide instead of the design's pill. Confirmed by a standalone debug mount reading `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--radius-pill')` against the real theme.css + globals.css bundle: returns the empty string. This lane writes no product code (dispatch: 'NO product code is written by this lane'); the fix (delete the redundant redeclaration at line 213, or point it at a differently-named canonical token) belongs to a product lane, flagged here with its exact line and mechanism per CLAUDE.md rule 13 ('a flag is a commitment'). FIXED by fix58-tokens (2026-09-07): theme.css's self-referential redeclaration removed; `--radius-pill` now resolves to 999px sitewide.

notes: The mount is the REAL AppShell wrapping DashboardBrief and RegulationDetailSurface, so the nav card, the content column, the dashboard section cards, the detail header and the detail action row are all in ONE measured tree. Composing the two surfaces together is an audit fixture, not a claim the product renders them together.

Nav card top margin is expected at 20px per operator ruling 4.2 ('margin: 20px 0 16px 16px so it aligns with the content column's 20px top padding. Fix it in the frame, once'). The artboard markup still shows 16px; the ruling supersedes it.

Ruling 5.1 requires a 3px graduated rule ABOVE each section title (full card width, top edge, no radius, linear-gradient(90deg,#5A5552,#5A5552 22%,rgba(90,85,82,.18))) and NO line below the title. Selector repair, train 58 (2026-09-07): the earlier `[data-section-rule]` selector never matched anything; the dashboard's Card DOES render the shared `SectionRule` component (`src/components/ui/SectionRule.tsx`, marker class `.cl-section-rule`, confirmed by direct source read this session, `src/components/dashboard/DashboardBrief.tsx` line ~121) — the check below now measures the real element.

Ruling 5.2's sitewide count ('one coloured rule per screen') cannot be counted reliably today: BandGradientRule renders an unmarked `div[aria-hidden="true"]`, and the four-band gradient is not distinguishable by computed style alone from the ImpactMeter ramp or the full MilestoneTimeline track, which are also green-to-red gradients at similar heights. This spec therefore checks the ONE permitted instance exactly (the nav card cap) and forbids a band-proportion rule inside a page masthead. Adding `data-band-rule` to BandGradientRule would make the sitewide count a one-line check; that is a recommendation for the fix lane, not a deviation.

Operator report 2026-09-07 ('the side navigation bar does not reach the length of the page'), CONFIRMED against every page artboard: the nav card is `align-self:stretch` inside the frame's `grid-template-columns:252px 1fr` and spans the full page height, footer rows at its foot. The build's `aside` previously carried `maxHeight: calc(100vh - 36px)` with no `align-self` of its own and ended at its content height instead. Fixed at the root in `Sidebar.tsx` (`align-self:stretch`, `height:auto`, no `maxHeight`) and in `AppShell.tsx` (the frame row's `display:flex`/height made inline, not Tailwind-class-only, so this harness — which injects only globals.css/theme.css, no compiled Tailwind CSS — has a real box to stretch against). The two rows below assert it: `align-self` reads back `stretch`, and `height` on this fixture (frame row's inline `height:100vh` at the harness's fixed 1400px page height) resolves to the frame height (1400px) minus the card's own vertical margins (20px top + 16px bottom = 36px) minus its own 1px top+bottom border (`box-sizing:content-box`, so the CSS `height` property excludes it) = 1362px — i.e. the card's rendered (border) box is exactly 1364px, equal to the frame's box, not its own content's height; the 1362px this row asserts is that same box read back through `getComputedStyle`'s content-box `height`, confirmed against `getBoundingClientRect().height === 1364` directly in the fixture.

notes: Sidebar.tsx's desktop nav card mixes inline style with Tailwind utility classes (`text-xl uppercase`, `text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.15em] uppercase`, etc. on the title/tagline). This harness injects `globals.css`/`theme.css` as RAW text without running Tailwind's build step (no PostCSS/Vite plugin — see mounts.mjs's STYLE_INJECT), so Tailwind's `@import "tailwindcss"` and its generated utility classes never resolve in this measured tree: a Tailwind-only property (e.g. the title's `text-xl` font-size) reads back as the browser's un-styled default, which is a HARNESS LIMITATION, not a product value — confirmed empirically (probed `aside.hidden > div:nth-child(2) h1` font-size: read 32px, the UA default h1 size, and text-transform: none, neither of which Sidebar.tsx's own inline style sets). This spec therefore asserts ONLY properties Sidebar.tsx sets via inline `style={}`, which bypass Tailwind entirely and are real regardless of this harness's raw-injection limitation. Title/tagline font-size, weight and text-transform (all Tailwind-class-driven in the desktop card) are NOT asserted here for that reason, not because they are known-correct.

The aside's own box model (width 252, margin, background, border, radius, band-gradient cap) is already covered by spec/page-frame.json's own top-level target on this same mount/selector; this spec adds the nav card's INTERNAL typography and active-state treatment, which page-frame.json does not touch.

"Watching" : "Watch"}` with no third, hover-only state — the control has no hover-driven text swap at all, so there is no element a selector could address for an 'Unwatch' string; this is stated in prose rather than forced into a spurious selector check, per this harness's own rule (a false MISMATCH is worse than no audit, CLAUDE.md rule 14). The gap is real and is the second half of the same ruling the row-label check below confirms the first half of.

rows.target: exactly one '+ Tag' trigger in the detail header (operator 3.2, mechanism repair train 58 2026-09-07)
rows.note: Operator 3.2: 'The action-row + Tag is the only trigger. Applied workspace tags still render as a row under the title; that row displays tags, it does not carry the trigger.' RESOLVED (found and fixed independently by two fix lanes, fix58-tokens and fix58-detail, 2026-09-07): the count-5 finding was a HARNESS bug, not a product defect. A standalone debug mount (`page.evaluate` against this exact selector, no `textMatch` filter applied) confirmed `header:not(.cl-masthead) button` matches all 5 ActionRow buttons (the row-overflow '⋯' menu, Export brief, Share, ☆ Watch, + Tag) — `textMatch: "Tag"` above was meant to narrow that down to the one button whose text contains 'Tag', exactly the way `forbid` entries already use `textMatch` (readForbid, run-audit.mjs). But `targetsOf()`/`readTarget()` (the non-forbid path) silently dropped the `textMatch` field for `children`/top-level `expect` targets — it was read into the target object nowhere, so the filter never ran and the raw 5-button count leaked through. Fixed at the root, once, in run-audit.mjs (`targetsOf` now carries `textMatch` through, `readTarget` applies the same filter `readForbid` already does) rather than reshaping this selector around the bug. RegulationDetailSurface.tsx (line ~193, ~209) already wires exactly one '+ Tag' trigger (ActionRow's own, via `onTag`) and DetailTagRow renders no trigger of its own (TagPopover's `open`/`onOpenChange` controlled mode) — the product was already correct; only the measurement was wrong.

The text filter is needed because BackToTop.tsx carries the IDENTICAL `fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40` class set, so the bare selector matches two controls stacked at the same coordinates. BackToTop is outside every ruling in the operator's list and is left exactly as it is; it is logged here as an observation, not a finding.

ONE scoped CommandBar') renders that command bar inside its own `<header class="cl-masthead">`, which is itself inside `[data-audit="regulation-detail"]`. `:not(.cl-masthead)` excludes that legitimate header so this forbid targets only a SECOND, different header carrying a command bar — which is what ruling 2.3 actually forbids.

rows.note: Artboard: grid-template-columns:96px 1fr; gap:7px 12px. Selector repair, train 58 (2026-09-07): the DOM is one level deeper than the old 2-level `>div>div` chain reached — AtAGlanceCard's root div has TWO div children (the `.cl-section-rule` rule and the padded content div), and `>div>div` matched the FIRST of those (the rule div, which has no grid styling at all), silently measuring the wrong element and reporting its `none`/`normal`/`normal` defaults as a design MISMATCH. The grid lives one level further in, inside the padded div — the 3-level selector now reaches it (confirmed by direct source read this session, `src/components/detail/DetailShell.tsx` AtAGlanceCard, ~line 658). SPEC CORRECTION, fix lane fix58-detail (2026-09-07): the `1fr` track literal is not a value CSSOM ever reports back — `getComputedStyle` resolves a `1fr` track to its USED pixel width (this mount measured `158px`, the mount's own fixed rail width minus the 96px label column and gaps), per this harness's own documented convention (`run-audit/README.md` step 3, 'Value forms'): `*` is the wildcard token whose 'only honest use is the 1fr track in a grid-template-columns list'. Corrected `1fr` to `*` here; the fixed `96px` label-column value is unchanged and still the real finding this row exists to catch.

rows.note: dc.html p15: `min-height:48px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06)`. Selector repair, train 58 (2026-09-07): the body (bodyPad) div holding NotificationPreferences is section's THIRD div child (after the rule div and the header div), not its second — `nth-child(2)` was reaching the header row itself, which has no `div` grandchild matching the rest of the chain, hence NOT BUILT.
